lead.event: HSC stock exclusions increase big-bank weights in the IHSG
lead.headline: HSC stock exclusion raises BBCA, BBRI and BMRI's combined IHSG weight to 25.4%
lead.blurb: Excluding High Shareholding Concentration stocks from the IHSG calculation left Bank Central Asia and Bank Rakyat Indonesia at the 9% cap each. Bank Mandiri’s weight rose from 5.9% to 7.4%. Analysts warned the greater concentration makes the IHSG more sensitive to banking-sector sentiment. One report said a simultaneous 1% decline in the three banks could pressure the index by roughly 0.25%.

earnings_guidance.event: BBCA raises its 2026 loan growth target
earnings_guidance.headline: BBCA raises 2026 loan growth target to 10%-11%
earnings_guidance.blurb: BCA cited resilient corporate and SME lending amid tightening industry liquidity, while consumer lending remains weak as quarterly auto loan repayments exceed new bookings. Management expects 2027 loan growth to be broadly similar to 2026.

earnings_guidance.event: Poultry issuers report nine-month results and receive analyst recommendations
earnings_guidance.headline: Poultry issuers report nine-month growth as analyst targets JPFA at Rp3,140
earnings_guidance.blurb: JPFA, CPIN, MAIN and WMPP all grew revenue and net profit through Q3. Kiwoom's Abdul Azis Setyo Wibowo rated Japfa Comfeed Indonesia a buy with a Rp3,140 target, while Mirae's Nafan Aji Gusta recommended wait and see on all four. CPIN's net profit rose 54% to Rp5.18 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: Industrial estate issuers report divergent nine-month results
earnings_guidance.headline: Industrial estate issuers post divergent nine-month results as DMAS profit rises 284%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Puradelta Lestari's net profit reached Rp1.49 trillion, with its industrial segment contributing Rp2.54 trillion, about 96% of revenue. Surya Semesta's profit rose to Rp344.44 billion, while Jababeka's fell 38% to Rp391.7 billion after one-off refinancing costs despite 16% revenue growth.

earnings_guidance.event: Diamond Propertindo reports a sharp increase in nine-month profit
earnings_guidance.headline: DADA reports nine-month profit up 863.76%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Diamond Propertindo shares had fallen 66% from Rp50 on 25 September and hit the lower price limit in the latest session. Net profit reached Rp8.24 billion for the period ended 30 September, while revenue rose 220% to Rp28.96 billion.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

deals_control.event: BRMS president director accumulates company shares
deals_control.headline: BRMS president director buys 15.16 million shares
deals_control.blurb: Bumi Resources Minerals shares fell 30.6% to Rp308 between 21 October and 6 November, despite President Director Agoes Projosasmito's purchases. He bought the shares for Rp6.45 billion at an average Rp425.49 each, while five other directors also bought shares, bringing total board holdings to around 23 million.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

deals_control.event: Bakrie Kalila Investment sells ENRG shares
deals_control.headline: ENRG shareholder Bakrie Kalila sells shares for Rp312.66 billion
deals_control.blurb: Energi Mega Persada shareholder Bakrie Kalila's reported sale figures differ on the quantity and timing. One report says its holding stood at 6.44% after a further 5 million shares were sold on 3 November, while Syailendra Bakrie's Shima Global Kapital sold 14 million shares and retained 11.65%.

deals_control.event: ENRG shares see large negotiation-market transactions
deals_control.headline: ENRG records more than Rp1.3 trillion in negotiation-market trades
deals_control.blurb: Energi Mega Persada shares changed hands in two transactions covering 15.81 million lots at Rp550 per share, worth Rp869.8 billion, and four transactions covering 7.62 million lots at Rp565, worth Rp430.6 billion. No official explanation has been issued.

deals_control.event: ULTJ plans a rights issue to acquire Frisian Flag Indonesia
deals_control.headline: ULTJ shareholders approve rights issue for 100% FFI acquisition at 6 November EGM
deals_control.blurb: The issue is priced at Rp2,150 a share, with 86.01% of net proceeds intended for the acquisition and the remainder for working capital. On completion, FCIH would become ULTJ’s controlling party, followed by a mandatory tender offer for publicly held shares.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

market_structure_policy.event: IDX suspends and investigates Remitra Global after a sharp share-price surge
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX suspends and investigates MKNT after 3,100% share-price surge
market_structure_policy.blurb: As of 5 November, IDX said a small group held 99.64% of Mitra Komunikasi Nusantara’s shares, placing it on its high shareholding concentration list but saying this did not indicate a rules violation. The suspension covers the Regular and Cash Markets from the 6 November pre-opening session until further exchange announcement.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: IDX said a small group of shareholders held 99.64% of MKNT shares as of 5 November.

market_structure_policy.event: Government prepares a single-door export scheme for strategic commodities
market_structure_policy.headline: Government prepares single-door export scheme for three commodities
market_structure_policy.blurb: The scheme covers coal, palm oil and iron alloy, with PT Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia as sole intermediary approving export declaration drafts. Customs clearance remains with the Directorate General of Customs and Excise and Indonesia National Single Window. Revised regulations are expected in mid-November, ahead of a pilot expected to begin 15 December.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Medco Energi issues bonds through Medco Redwood Tree
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MEDC issues 2032 bonds with an 8.875% coupon
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Medco Energi issued the bonds through subsidiary Medco Redwood Tree Limited under Rule 144A/Reg S, with a guarantee from parent MedcoEnergi. Net proceeds are intended to refinance or repay existing debt, which MedcoEnergi said would support a balanced debt maturity profile.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: GOTO buyback and cancellation of treasury shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: GOTO shareholders approve cancellation of around 32 billion treasury shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: GoTo had spent Rp985 billion to repurchase 36 billion shares by 29 October, with roughly Rp2.5 trillion remaining under its authorization through June 2027. Shareholders approved removing shares equal to about 2.7% of total shares outstanding from issuance on 14 October, raising existing investors’ ownership percentages and preventing the shares from returning to the market.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: KB Bank postpones its planned US dollar global bond issuance
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BBKP postpones planned US$300 million global bond issuance
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: KB Bank cited global and domestic market conditions affecting funding costs and terms, and reported a Q3 2026 net loss of Rp184.17 billion and a gross NPL ratio of 10.26% in September. Its US$300 million notes issued in October 2024 mature on 30 October 2027, with shareholder support and domestic issuance among the alternatives.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BRIS shareholders approve a second rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BRIS shareholders approve second rights issue of up to 6.8 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bank Syariah Indonesia's public shareholding is around 9.9%. The bank says the offering aims to strengthen capital, increase public ownership and expand financing capacity as projected capital needs rise to Rp64.41 trillion in 2027 from Rp51.07 trillion in 2026.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

other.event: RANS shares fall amid controversy over its Yogyakarta carnival
other.headline: RANS shares fall 51.1% amid controversy over Yogyakarta carnival
other.blurb: Rans Entertainment said several performers withdrew from the 31 October to 1 November event, but denied instructing, initiating or funding alleged Rp50,000 payments to mobilize residents. It said the controversy has no material impact on operations or finances and is still evaluating the event’s revenue and costs.
